title: Corridor-Pivot Recruiting for Displaced Gulf Migrants
cluster_name: Singular / uncategorized
one_liner: When Gulf jobs disappear, retrain returnees and place them in Japan, Taiwan and Germany with the employer paying the fee.

title: Agent-Access Terms Index for Enterprises
cluster_name: Merchants and bureaucracies that AI agents cannot reach or navigate
one_liner: A living database and alert feed of what the top 500 SaaS and data vendors allow, meter and prohibit when your AI agents touch their APIs and data.

title: Guild-Issued Credentials That Beat Free Badges
cluster_name: Creators proving authorship and stopping unauthorized AI use of their work
one_liner: Turn illustrator, photographer, translator and indie-label associations into verifiers that issue portable 'real working creator' credentials.

title: Verified-Guardian Credential Built on Childcare Centers
cluster_name: Youth online safety and age-assurance compliance for small platforms
one_liner: Start as a custody-aware pickup and consent app for childcare centers, then turn those institutions into issuers of privacy-preserving 'verified parent of a child aged X' tokens that apps pay for.

title: Fall Response Network for Meteorite Hunters
cluster_name: Novel environmental and infrastructure data from satellites and crowd-sensing
one_liner: Rapid strewn-field prediction plus standard landowner-permission contracts and a fresh-fall sales channel for meteorite hunters, extendable to satellite-debris reentries.

title: Royalty Marketplace for Expert Agent Skills
cluster_name: Rights-cleared human data and vetted expert workers for AI labs
one_liner: Retired and displaced specialists package their procedures, judgment rubrics and worked examples as machine-loadable skill packs that companies' agents pull on demand, with per-run metering and royalties to the author.

title: Offline Distilled Agent Box for Denied Networks
cluster_name: Singular / uncategorized
one_liner: Ruggedized GPU box that runs small models distilled from a unit's own GenAI.mil agents, with zero connectivity.

title: Purge-to-Spool Toll Recycler for Print Farms
cluster_name: Recycling quality, distressed capacity and battery/EPR compliance
one_liner: A mail-in service that turns multicolour purge waste and failed prints into laser-checked, guaranteed-diameter filament, so print farms get spools back without owning or babysitting a $1,200-$1,700 recycling rig.

title: Guardrail Gateway for Law-Firm AI Agents
cluster_name: Accountability and guardrails for AI agents acting for others
one_liner: A policy proxy between AI agents and practice-management, billing and trust-accounting systems that enforces ethics rules (trust funds, conflicts, confidentiality) and logs every action for the bar and the insurer.

title: Marginalia: Lived-Experience Annotated Books
cluster_name: Singular / uncategorized
one_liner: One-of-one physical books annotated in ink by people who have actually lived what the book is about, such as a retired ER nurse in The Plague or a lighthouse keeper's daughter in To the Lighthouse.

title: Compliance Runtime and Audit for AI Wellness Apps
cluster_name: Emotional-AI companions: dependence, harm and continuity
one_liner: One API that applies each state's rules for companion and wellness chatbots by user location, logs the evidence, and produces the audit reports regulators and insurers ask for.

title: Actual-Play Sessions Turned Into Animated Episodes
cluster_name: Independent game studios and creator businesses
one_liner: A pipeline that turns a tabletop RPG stream's audio and character art into a condensed animated episode using the cast's own voices, with human review.

title: Compliance-First CDL School Roll-Up for Carriers
cluster_name: Skilled-trades labor gap
one_liner: Buy the clean CDL schools that survived the federal crackdown, run them with AI scheduling and audit-ready records, and get paid per hired graduate by carriers.

title: Benefits Administrator for Pet-Care Subsidies
cluster_name: Pet owners and insurers squeezed by rising vet bills
one_liner: When hundreds of millions in philanthropy and city funds must reach the right households through thousands of small clinics, someone needs the HSA-administrator equivalent: eligibility, vouchers, payment and audit.

title: Asset Provenance Ledger for AI Disclosure
cluster_name: Creators proving authorship and stopping unauthorized AI use of their work
one_liner: A plugin for Blender, Photoshop, Unity and Unreal that logs where each asset came from (human-made, AI-generated, purchased) and exports evidence for Steam disclosure and award eligibility.

title: Stablecoin Cash-Out Float for Corner Shops
cluster_name: Cross-border money movement and stablecoin rails
one_liner: Stablecoins made sending money nearly free, so the scarce thing is cash at the last mile, and the margin goes to whoever finances the agents.

title: Size Ladder: Circular Wardrobes for GLP-1 Users
cluster_name: Businesses adapting to GLP-1 users' changed consumption
one_liner: A subscription that ships the next clothing size on the GLP-1 titration schedule, takes back the last, stores a 'restart' wardrobe, and routes the excess into resale and recycling, sold through telehealth partners as a retention perk.

title: Sovereign Data Vaults in Orbit
cluster_name: New-space economy: operator gaps and LEO service users' risks
one_liner: Encrypted national-records backups stored in orbit, out of reach of seizure, cyber-wipe or flood.

title: Savings-Group Credit Score and Treasury
cluster_name: Informal finance and payment frictions in emerging markets
one_liner: Turn informal savings groups into a credit bureau and stablecoin treasury that asset financiers can lend against.

title: Paid Holds: Options Market for Booking Agents
cluster_name: Merchants and bureaucracies that AI agents cannot reach or navigate
one_liner: A merchant plugin that sells time-limited holds on appointments, tables and inventory to shopping and booking agents, so agent traffic becomes fee revenue for the merchant instead of something to block.

title: Tele-Operated Night Aides for Small Care Homes
cluster_name: Teleoperated labor and remote pilot workforces
one_liner: Metered remote-aide hours operating an off-the-shelf mobile manipulator robot in 6-16 bed residential care homes, so labor crosses borders when workers cannot.

title: Agent-Bookable Gateway for Local Trades
cluster_name: Merchants and bureaucracies that AI agents cannot reach or navigate
one_liner: A per-business endpoint that lets consumers' AI agents get a photo-based quote, hold a slot and pay a deposit at a local trade without a phone call.

title: Sub-Tier Surge Twin for the Industrial Base
cluster_name: US machine shops and reshoring manufacturers
one_liner: A digital twin of foundries, forges and motor makers that shows which supplier breaks first in a 180-day fight.

title: Cross-Border Income Passport for Freelancers
cluster_name: Gig, tipped and cash workers unable to prove income
one_liner: Give stablecoin-paid remote workers a verifiable, portable income record that landlords, lenders and visa agents accept.

title: Babel Tables for Multilingual Community Programs
cluster_name: Language, hearing and communication barriers in services and workplaces
one_liner: A tabletop translation hub that lets a senior-center lunch, ESL class or church group hold one conversation across four languages in real time.

title: Paid Shelter-Dog Field Trips, Fees Per Adoption
cluster_name: Pets at risk: owner crises, shelters and transport paperwork
one_liner: Professional walkers take the longest-stay shelter dogs on 3-hour public field trips with photos and behavior reports, and shelters pay a small trip fee plus a success fee for each adoption.

title: Turn Podcast Fans Into Local Chapters
cluster_name: Loneliness and purpose: belonging programs for isolated adults and elders
one_liner: A chapter-in-a-box that lets mid-size creators convert engaged, lonely audiences into weekly local meetups, with insurance, host training and venues handled.

title: Drone-Ready Rx Lockers as Adherence Infrastructure
cluster_name: Adult children managing aging parents from afar
one_liner: A lockable, temperature-buffered, authenticated receiving station at a senior's home that accepts drone or courier drops and quietly reports whether the medication was retrieved.

title: Escrow Notary for Agents Hiring Humans
cluster_name: Payments, escrow, disputes and human fulfilment for agent transactions
one_liner: A neutral adjudication layer that agents pay per task to verify that a hired human really did the physical job before escrow releases, built to withstand AI-forged proof.

title: A Suable LLC With Reserves for Every Agent
cluster_name: Accountability and guardrails for AI agents acting for others
one_liner: Mass-produced, series-LLC legal wrappers that give each paid agent a registered agent for service of process, a capital reserve, and tax handling, so counterparties have someone to sue.

title: Vet-Verified Escrow for Puppy Purchases
cluster_name: Singular / uncategorized
one_liner: Buyer funds sit in escrow and release to the seller only after a licensed vet exam confirms the animal is healthy and the microchip matches.

title: Roll-Up of Compounding-Stranded Weight-Loss Clinics
cluster_name: Access, affordability and supply integrity for GLP-1 and compounded drugs
one_liner: Buy distressed med spas and weight-loss clinics that lost their compounded GLP-1 margin, and convert them into aftercare-plus-aesthetics businesses.

title: Satiety Peptides for Small-Portion Foods
cluster_name: Businesses adapting to GLP-1 users' changed consumption
one_liner: Screen food-grade peptides that trigger the body's own GLP-1 release and put them in high-protein snacks.

title: Waze for Agents: Live Bureaucracy Route Data
cluster_name: Merchants and bureaucracies that AI agents cannot reach or navigate
one_liner: A pay-per-lookup feed of the current, tested state of consumer and government web procedures (form changes, outages, hidden requirements, real step timings), sold to browser agents just before they attempt an errand.

title: Teleoperated Pack-and-Pick Robots Piloted from Latin America
cluster_name: Teleoperated labor and remote pilot workforces
one_liner: Robot arms run by foundation models, with remote pilots in Guatemala or Colombia fixing the edge cases, sold per box.

title: Guardrail Gateway for Hotel AI Agents
cluster_name: Accountability and guardrails for AI agents acting for others
one_liner: A proxy between hotel AI agents (voice, chat, booking) and PMS, POS and door-lock APIs that enforces per-action permissions, spend limits and human approval for irreversible actions.

title: Overtourism Feed for AI Travel Agents
cluster_name: Overtouristed destinations, tour operators and independent hotels
one_liner: A destination-signed, machine-readable feed of live capacity, closures and dispersal incentives that AI trip agents query, so places can steer planning before tourists arrive.

title: Peak-Season Exchange for Idle Warehouse Robot Hours
cluster_name: Deploying robots in the real world
one_liner: A marketplace and price index that moves idle AMRs and robots-as-a-service capacity between 3PLs and retailers to cover seasonal peaks, priced per robot-hour.

title: Surety-Bonded License Plates for AI Agents
cluster_name: Accountability and guardrails for AI agents acting for others
one_liner: A registrar that binds each autonomous agent to a legally accountable, insured principal through a surety bond and a revocable credential merchants and platforms can check.

title: Meeting Subtext Captions for Neurodivergent Workers
cluster_name: Language, hearing and communication barriers in services and workplaces
one_liner: An on-screen coach for Zoom and Teams that flags conversational subtext (a question aimed at you, a topic shift, rising frustration) and supports post-meeting debriefs, sold through autism and ADHD coaches.

title: Credit Union Tokenized Deposit Network
cluster_name: Cross-border money movement and stablecoin rails
one_liner: Give thousands of small credit unions a shared 24/7 tokenized-deposit settlement network so they can answer the 'war for deposits' together instead of losing it one by one.

title: Rent Ledger for Adult Kids Living at Home
cluster_name: Singular / uncategorized
one_liner: A simple lease, payment and credit-reporting layer that lets parents charge their adult children rent, build the kids' credit history, and quietly bank the money as a down-payment fund.

title: Lend Against Battery Earnings for Vet Bills
cluster_name: Pet owners and insurers squeezed by rising vet bills
one_liner: A wallet that routes VPP and demand-response payouts into a dedicated pet-care fund, then advances emergency vet money against the battery's telemetry-verified future earnings.

title: Pay-on-Green: Escrow Released by Executable Tests
cluster_name: Payments, escrow, disputes and human fulfilment for agent transactions
one_liner: Escrow for agent-to-agent work where the negotiated object is a hashed acceptance test, and money moves only when the test passes.

title: Remote-Piloted Care Robots: Labor by Teleoperation
cluster_name: Teleoperated labor and remote pilot workforces
one_liner: Mobile manipulators supervised by remote pilots handle non-clinical night-shift chores in memory care, importing labor by bandwidth instead of visa.

title: Worker-Owned Agentic Back-Office Cooperatives
cluster_name: Employers restructuring for AI: layoffs, severance and displaced workers
one_liner: A franchise-in-a-box that helps laid-off finance and admin staff form co-ops running agent-leveraged bookkeeping, payroll and billing services for local small businesses, keeping the surplus themselves.
